name: 35127 · Pleasant Grv, AL
findings: ZIP 35127 (Pleasant Grv) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35127 (Pleasant Grv) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
